title: Sprawl Crafting
description: Factorio style deferred crafting within your inventory
body: *You have your ingredients sprawled out, you just need to put them together.* Or something. IDK Factorio-style single-item crafting for the vanilla inventory and crafting table. Request a desired item and automatically craft every intermediate from your available raw resources, then the final result. Works with the vanilla recipe book and integrates with JEI/REI. Yellow recipes are ones that you can indirectly craft with the raw resources in your inventory. Right click on a red recipe to see what key items you are missing. Requires installation on a server for functionality in multiplayer.
